lines: d41: 📓 Codex: you've heard of Pocket Sand. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
d41: ◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Devon — Strange 1. Three offers; they took Pocket Sand. Earned, chosen. (pocket_sand: villager level-up)
d41: 📓 Codex: Devon chose Pocket Sand (pocket_sand) at Strange 1.
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Larry Simmons is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Larry Simmons is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Larry kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Larry's gone." Joyce looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Larry." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Devon blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Radios & Signals (Level 1). Continuity, batteries, and solder. Most dead electronics are just broken connections.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Larry Simmons, 41 days. The mantle passes to Devon Okafor.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Devon Okafor, 29 — a programmer. His hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Pocket Sand.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Larry — and Larry is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Joyce, Frank, Caleb and 1 more speak for Devon — "Larry trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Devon before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.

d95: 📖 LEARNED: Stone & Masonry (Level 1). Stack stone so it stands: batter the wall, heart it with rubble, cap it well.
d95: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d95: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)

d95: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Devon's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)

d95: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Devon Okafor, 95 days. The mantle passes to Victor Lopez.
d95: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Victor Lopez, 39 — a mason. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Beard Moss, Green Thumb, Literally, Cornucopia.
d95: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.

d95: You knew Devon — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting him, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)

d95: The fire knew Victor before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
